Weng.Access
Class AccessDb

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Access.AccessDb
public class AccessDb
extends java.lang.Object

An object of the class AccessDb serves as a proxy to a Microsoft Access database. Special low-level implementation issues require this class to be implemented as a factory. That is, the static method Create() is used to construct an AccessDb object, and the static method Destroy() is used to remove an AccessDb object.
